blocks.text: Jasmine Curtis-Smith is set to take on the lead role in the international independent romantic-comedy film “We Could Be in Love,” directed by Filipina filmmaker Marie Jamora. According to a report by The Hollywood Reporter on Monday, Oct. 5, production on the film has begun, with principal photography scheduled to take place in New York and Manila in November. Curtis-Smith will play Jasmine Aquino, a working-class Filipina-American woman who falls in love with the wealthy heir to a Chinese-Filipino dynasty, Ambrose Lee, played by Filipino-Malaysian actor Yao.
